verses.original: οὖν Εἰ συνηγέρθητε τῷ Χριστῷ ζητεῖτε τὰ ἄνω οὗ ὁ Χριστός ἐστιν καθήμενος ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: oun Ei synēgerthēte tō Christō zēteite ta anō hou ho Christos estin kathēmenos en dexia tou Theou
verses.literal: Therefore since you have been raised with - Christ strive for the things above where - Christ is seated at [the] right hand - of God

verses.original: φρονεῖτε τὰ ἄνω μὴ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τὰ
verses.transliteration: phroneite ta anō mē epi tēs gēs ta
verses.literal: Set [your] minds on things above not on - earthly things

verses.original: γάρ ἀπεθάνετε καὶ ὑμῶν ἡ ζωὴ κέκρυπται σὺν τῷ Χριστῷ ἐν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: gar apethanete kai hymōn hē zōē kekryptai syn tō Christō en tō Theō
verses.literal: For you died and your - life is now hidden with - Christ in - God

verses.original: ὅταν ὁ Χριστὸς ἡ ὑμῶν ζωὴ φανερωθῇ τότε ὑμεῖς καὶ φανερωθήσεσθε σὺν αὐτῷ ἐν δόξῃ
verses.transliteration: hotan ho Christos hē hymōn zōē phanerōthē tote hymeis kai phanerōthēsesthe syn autō en doxē
verses.literal: When - Christ who is your life appears then you also will appear with Him in glory

verses.original: Νεκρώσατε οὖν τὰ μέλη τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς πορνείαν ἀκαθαρσίαν πάθος κακήν ἐπιθυμίαν καὶ τὴν πλεονεξίαν ἥτις ἐστὶν εἰδωλολατρία
verses.transliteration: Nekrōsate oun ta melē ta epi tēs gēs porneian akatharsian pathos kakēn epithymian kai tēn pleonexian hētis estin eidōlolatria
verses.literal: Put to death therefore the components of your vvv vvv earthly nature sexual immorality impurity lust evil desires and - greed which is idolatry

verses.original: δι’ ἃ ἡ ὀργὴ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἔρχεται ἐπὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῆς ἀπειθείας
verses.transliteration: di’ ha hē orgē tou Theou erchetai epi tous huious tēs apeitheias
verses.literal: Because of these the wrath - of God is coming on the sons of disobedience

verses.original: ὅτε ἐζῆτε ἐν τούτοις ὑμεῖς καὶ ποτε περιεπατήσατέ ἐν οἷς
verses.transliteration: hote ezēte en toutois hymeis kai pote periepatēsate en hois
verses.literal: When you lived among them you also used to walk in these ways

verses.original: δὲ νυνὶ ὑμεῖς καὶ ἀπόθεσθε τὰ πάντα ὀργήν θυμόν κακίαν βλασφημίαν αἰσχρολογίαν ἐκ ὑμῶν τοῦ στόματος
verses.transliteration: de nyni hymeis kai apothesthe ta panta orgēn thymon kakian blasphēmian aischrologian ek hymōn tou stomatos
verses.literal: But now you - must put aside - all such things as these anger rage malice slander [and] filthy language from your - lips

verses.original: Μὴ ψεύδεσθε εἰς ἀλλήλους ἀπεκδυσάμενοι τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον σὺν αὐτοῦ ταῖς πράξεσιν
verses.transliteration: Mē pseudesthe eis allēlous apekdysamenoi ton palaion anthrōpon syn autou tais praxesin
verses.literal: {Do} not lie to one another since you have taken off the old self with [its] - practices

verses.original: καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι τὸν νέον τὸν ἀνακαινούμενον εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν κατ’ εἰκόνα τοῦ αὐτόν κτίσαντος
verses.transliteration: kai endysamenoi ton neon ton anakainoumenon eis epignōsin kat’ eikona tou auton ktisantos
verses.literal: and have put on the new [self] which is being renewed in knowledge in [the] image of [its] Creator

verses.original: ὅπου ἔνι οὐκ Ἕλλην καὶ Ἰουδαῖος περιτομὴ καὶ ἀκροβυστία βάρβαρος Σκύθης δοῦλος ἐλεύθερος ἀλλὰ Χριστός τὰ πάντα καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: hopou eni ouk Hellēn kai Ioudaios peritomē kai akrobystia barbaros Skythēs doulos eleutheros alla Christos ta panta kai en pasin
verses.literal: Here there is no Greek [or] Jew circumcised [or] uncircumcised barbarian Scythian slave [or] free but Christ [is] - all and [is] in all

verses.original: οὖν ὡς ἐκλεκτοὶ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἅγιοι καὶ ἠγαπημένοι Ἐνδύσασθε σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ χρηστότητα ταπεινοφροσύνην πραΰτητα μακροθυμίαν
verses.transliteration: oun hōs eklektoi tou Theou hagioi kai ēgapēmenoi Endysasthe splanchna oiktirmou chrēstotēta tapeinophrosynēn prautēta makrothymian
verses.literal: Therefore as [the] elect - of God holy and beloved clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion kindness humility gentleness [and] patience

verses.original: ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων καὶ χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς ἐάν τις μομφήν ἔχῃ πρός τινα οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς καθὼς καὶ ὁ Κύριος ἐχαρίσατο ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: anechomenoi allēlōn kai charizomenoi heautois ean tis momphēn echē pros tina houtōs kai hymeis kathōs kai ho Kyrios echarisato hymin
verses.literal: Bear with one another and forgive - vvv [any] complaint you may have against someone else vvv vvv Forgive as . . . the Lord forgave you

verses.original: δὲ ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τούτοις τὴν ἀγάπην ὅ ἐστιν σύνδεσμος τῆς τελειότητος
verses.transliteration: de epi pasin toutois tēn agapēn ho estin syndesmos tēs teleiotētos
verses.literal: And over all these [virtues] - [put on] love which is [the] bond - of perfect unity

verses.original: καὶ ἡ εἰρήνη τοῦ Χριστοῦ βραβευέτω ἐν ὑμῶν ταῖς καρδίαις εἰς ἣν καὶ ἐκλήθητε ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι καὶ γίνεσθε εὐχάριστοι
verses.transliteration: kai hē eirēnē tou Christou brabeuetō en hymōn tais kardiais eis hēn kai eklēthēte en heni sōmati kai ginesthe eucharistoi
verses.literal: - {Let} the peace - of Christ rule in your - hearts [for] to this - you were called as members of one body And be thankful

verses.original: Ὁ λόγος τοῦ Χριστοῦ πλουσίως ἐνοικείτω ἐν ὑμῖν διδάσκοντες καὶ νουθετοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ ᾄδοντες ψαλμοῖς ὕμνοις πνευματικαῖς ᾠδαῖς ἐν τῇ χάριτι ἐν ταῖς ὑμῶν καρδίαις τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Ho logos tou Christou plousiōs enoikeitō en hymin didaskontes kai nouthetountes heautous en pasē sophia adontes psalmois hymnois pneumatikais ōdais en tē chariti en tais hymōn kardiais tō Theō
verses.literal: {Let} the word - of Christ richly dwell within you as you teach and admonish one another with all wisdom [and] as you sing psalms hymns [and] spiritual songs with - gratitude in - your hearts to God

verses.original: καὶ πᾶν ὅ τι ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἐν λόγῳ ἢ ἐν ἔργῳ πάντα ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ Θεῷ Πατρὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai pan ho ti ean poiēte en logō ē en ergō panta en onomati Kyriou Iēsou eucharistountes tō Theō Patri di’ autou
verses.literal: And whatever . . . . . . . . . you do in word or - deed [do it] all in [the] name of [the] Lord Jesus giving thanks - to God [the] Father through Him

verses.original: Αἱ γυναῖκες ὑποτάσσεσθε τοῖς ἀνδράσιν ὡς ἀνῆκεν ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Hai gynaikes hypotassesthe tois andrasin hōs anēken en Kyriō
verses.literal: - Wives submit to [your] husbands as is fitting in [the] Lord

verses.original: Οἱ ἄνδρες ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ μὴ πικραίνεσθε πρὸς αὐτάς
verses.transliteration: Hoi andres agapate tas gynaikas kai mē pikrainesthe pros autas
verses.literal: - Husbands love [your] wives and {do} not be harsh with them

verses.original: Τὰ τέκνα ὑπακούετε τοῖς γονεῦσιν κατὰ πάντα γὰρ τοῦτο ἐστιν εὐάρεστόν ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: Ta tekna hypakouete tois goneusin kata panta gar touto estin euareston en Kyriō
verses.literal: - Children obey [your] parents in everything for this is pleasing to [the] Lord

verses.original: Οἱ πατέρες μὴ ἐρεθίζετε ὑμῶν τὰ τέκνα ἵνα μὴ ἀθυμῶσιν
verses.transliteration: Hoi pateres mē erethizete hymōn ta tekna hina mē athymōsin
verses.literal: - Fathers {do} not provoke your - children so vvv they will not become discouraged

verses.original: Οἱ δοῦλοι ὑπακούετε τοῖς κατὰ σάρκα κυρίοις κατὰ πάντα μὴ ὡς ἀνθρωπάρεσκοι ἐν ὀφθαλμοδουλίαις ἀλλ’ ἐν ἁπλότητι καρδίας φοβούμενοι τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: Hoi douloi hypakouete tois kata sarka kyriois kata panta mē hōs anthrōpareskoi en ophthalmodouliais all’ en haplotēti kardias phoboumenoi ton Kyrion
verses.literal: - Slaves obey [your] earthly . . . masters in everything not [only] vvv to please them vvv while they are watching but with sincerity of heart [and] fear of the Lord

verses.original: Ὃ ἐὰν ποιῆτε ἐργάζεσθε ἐκ ψυχῆς ὡς τῷ Κυρίῳ καὶ οὐκ ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: Ho ean poiēte ergazesthe ek psychēs hōs tō Kyriō kai ouk anthrōpois
verses.literal: Whatever . . . you do work at it vvv with your whole being as for the Lord and not for men

verses.original: εἰδότες ὅτι ἀπολήμψεσθε τῆς κληρονομίας ἀπὸ Κυρίου τὴν ἀνταπόδοσιν τῷ Κυρίῳ Χριστῷ δουλεύετε
verses.transliteration: eidotes hoti apolēmpsesthe tēs klēronomias apo Kyriou tēn antapodosin tō Kyriō Christō douleuete
verses.literal: because you know that you will receive - an inheritance from [the] Lord [as your] reward [It is] the Lord Christ you are serving

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ ἀδικῶν κομίσεται ὃ ἠδίκησεν καὶ ἔστιν οὐκ προσωπολημψία
verses.transliteration: gar ho adikōn komisetai ho ēdikēsen kai estin ouk prosōpolēmpsia
verses.literal: - Whoever does wrong will be repaid [for] vvv his wrong and there is no favoritism
